PROSPECTUS
                   2025-26




BOKO : KAMRUP : ASSAM
 From Principal’s Desk….

Warm Greetings !

       As a premier institute of higher education at Boko, Jawaharlal Nehru College has successfully
crossed the threshold of its glorious 60 years and this relentless stride continues with renewed vigour
to overcome the future challenges on the wait. The college since its inception in 1964 has been
fervently committed in the pursuit of knowledge dissemination, preservation and generation.

               “The mind is not a vessel to be filled, but a fire to be kindled”. - Plutarch

       Jawaharlal Nehru College as a leading institute of Higher Education in South Kamrup is
committed in the pursuit of knowledge dissemination, preservation and generation in fulfilment of its
noble vision of moulding responsible individuals for leading a society with desire for progress and
prosperity by kindling the mind in the pursuit path of knowledge acquisition, preservation and
propagation spreading the wings of fire for all round development of the student.

       “Give a man a fish and you feed him for a day; Teach a man to fish and you feed him for a
lifetime” –Maimonides

       The regular dissemination of knowledge of Jawaharlal Nehru College bolstered with NEP 2020
has left no stone unturned in promoting Skill and Entrepreneurship development. As a testimony to
this mission, the college has launched the Entrepreneurship development Cell supported by North East
Council (NEC). The institute is also adequately gearing for offering Internship programmes as per the
mandate of the GU course. These multidimensional exposures pledge to transform the life of the
students by providing skill empowerment.

       It is a firm conviction that the path of progress of our HEI would proceed undauntedly with
sincere and diligent staff of the college and indispensable co-operation, association of various
communities in Boko for reaching greater heights in the field higher education.

       With these words, I welcome all the budding aspirants to join Jawaharlal Nehru College family.

Brief History of the College:

       During the early sixties, the ideas of opening an institution of higher education in the remote
part of South Kamrup came to the mind of the people of Boko area Late Prabin Kumar Choudhury, the
then Minister of Transport, Assam, who represented the Boko Constituency of the Assam Assembly
and Late Achyut Kanta Adhikary took the leading role in the establishment of a college at Boko and he
was given the charge as part time honorary In-charge Principal & Secretary on 1st August 1964. In the
 long run, the college came in to existence on 3rd August, 1964 and named it after the hallowed
memory of Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, independent India's first Prime Minister who had breathed his last
on 27th May in that year. The liberal policy of the Gauhati Uiversity in granting the affiliation to
colleges of rural areas extended a positive support of this institution to emerge. Under the stewardships
of Prabin Kumar Choudhury and Achyut Kanta Adhikary, the institution has made remarkable
progress. His Excellency the Governor of Assam was pleased to allot 100 bighas of land (33 acre
approx.) for the college at Jarapara V.G.R., two km west of Boko Police Station on the northern side of
NH-37. On 1st of September 1965, Mr. J.C. Nath took over the charge of full time Principal of the
institution and served the college till 31st May 1995. Thereafter, the college received 1st Degree
Affiliation in the year 1967 from the Gauhati University. The Arts stream received Deficit Grants in
Aid on 1st September 1969. The college was provincialized from 1st December 2005. The Science
stream was started in the year 1986 and on received Deficit Grants in Aid o 25th March 1998.

From its inception the college has traversed a steady course towards expanding its academic and
infrastructural needs. At present there are 14 departments with honours, nine in Arts stream and five in
Science stream. Beyond that the college has initiated PG courses in Assamese and Mathematics, Post
Graduate Diploma in Computer Application, some career oriented and vocational courses to cater to
the needs of the students of the locality.
       At present the college has grown up into a full-fledged well-known institution with academic
excellence and co-curricular activities, particularly in the field of games and sports, culture, literature
and social activities. The college is going to celebrate its glorious Diamond Jubilee year from August,
2023. To identify its strengths and weaknesses in the present-day context the college has got itself
accredited by the NAAC for its third cycle this year and accorded with B++ grade. After receiving the
prestigious Star Status from the DBT, Govt. of India in 2019, our college has set a benchmark and
became the first college of Assam to receive Star Status from the Department of Biotechnology Govt.
of India. To equip our youths with 21st Century skill, the college is planning to establish a "Remote
Pilot Training Organization" (Drone Pilot training) Centre in collaboration with NECTAR, a Govt. of
India organization to start DDCA approved Certificate Course from this academic Session.
From the academic session 2023-24, Four Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUP) under Gauhati
University have been introduced in the line of NEP 2020 and admission will be done through the
SAMARTH-e suit platform introduced by the MOE, Govt of India.
From the academic session 2025-26, the Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) is
launched by the college after formal approval by NCTE. Under this programme, NTA or National
 Testing Agency conducts the National Common Entrance Test (NCET) for admission to the 4 Year
ITEP in the college.

       Location: The college is situated at a distance of 60 kilometers west of Guwahati. The college
is well connected with Guwahati, the capital of Assam by road and railway services. The cardinal point
of the college is 25.570 North and 91.12° East. The college is standing on the National Highway No.
17. The interstate boundary between Assam and Meghalaya is just 10 km south of the college and
Chamaria, a village of Vaishnavite culture is located at 13 k.m. North. The inter district boundary
between Kamrup and Goalpara is a distance of 10 k.m. West of the college.

 College Emblem: The burning flame at the center of the emblem represents the spreading of
 knowledge. The rose above the basement of the emblem represents the fragrance of wisdom.
 The name of the college is engraved on the circumference of the emblem with the motto of
 the college encrypted in Sanskrit as “Saa Vidya ya vimuktye’ which means education is that
 which liberates.



  Our Vision
  To set a hallmark in the field of education and preserve, create and disseminate
    knowledge through teaching, learning, innovation and experimentation to mould
    responsible individuals for leading a society with desire for progress and prosperity of
    human race.



  Our Missions
  • To inculcate a value system amongst students for boosting moral, ethical and social

    responsibilities for development of human resources.
  • To enhance the academic environment with an aim to fulfil the demands of NEP 2020

    and cater to arising needs academic and co-curricular in nature with developed
    competency.
  • With a rich ethnic diversity around, the college has a mission to engage the expertise
     of the qualified pool of faculties in the process of identification, experimentation and
    preservation of resources and traditional knowledge and simultaneously develop
    awareness for its sustenance and continuity.
• To create conducive environment with facilities enriching provisions for promotion of

    quality research
• To enrich the college-community link by creating a sustainable learning environment

    based on learning pedagogy with aid of digital technology for an enhanced experience
    for both the learners and educators.
• To foster scope for skill development in tandem with national 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' for

    building self-sustenance, adaptability and scope for employment.
• To strive towards academic excellence with exposure to digitized learning and also

    promote the indigenous art, culture, craftwork as well as participation in sports and
    games.
• To widen scope of resource mobility of college by working on viable areas of

    production and thereby grow as a self-sustaining institute.
• To develop the college as one of the best colleges in the state with state-of-the art

    facilities for education
•         To make higher education a part of the social environment through community
    participation and sustainable development to eliminate social evils that persists in the
    region and thereby create social harmony.

                                   ADMISSION PROCEDURE
ADMISSION IN H.S. PROGRAMME UNDER ASSEB
Admission procedure is purely online. An applicant has to go through the following steps to apply online-
Step 1 : An applicant has to visit DARPAN portal of ASSEB and to apply for admission giving
necessary information. They have to select Jawaharlal Nehru College in the college name. Our college
will select students from the DARPAN portal as per capacity of the college in each stream. The merit list
prepared through DARPAN will be displayed in the college website/portal and admission will be held as
per date, venue and time to be declared by the college in notice board and in the college web portal
www.jncollegeonline.co.in.
Moreover students have to apply in the college online portal also. For this they have to visit the college
website www.jncollegeboko.ac.in. Then click on “Online portal” button available in the website. A new
page will open up where the applicant has to click “Apply Online”.
Step 2 : The applicant should click “New Enrolment” and when new window will open up he/she will
have to register by filling up required fields. The applicant should have a valid Email ID (preferably at
Gmail) and a mobile number for registration. Login by using your mobile umber as user ID and giving
your own pass word. Only One mobile number can use by one applicant.
Step 3 : After successful registration the applicant will have to fill up the admission form as per his/her
requirement. Along with other details he/she should put bank accounts details like Bank name, branch,
account numbers, IFSC.
Step 4 : Then he/she has to upload his/her passport size photograph and scanned signature there.
Step 5 : The he/she should upload scanned copies of following documents :
       Last examination Mark-sheet.
       Last examination Certificate.
       Caste Certificate
       NCC/Extra Curricular Certificate (Where applicable)
       Front page of Bank Passbook/ Cheque
       Gap certificate (Where applicable)
       Migration Certificate (For applicant of other states)
Step 6 : Before final submission the applicant will review the filled data for any necessary modification. If
any correction/modification needed he/she will make the correction and then submit the form by clicking
“Final Submission” button. Applicant should remember that once submitted there is no scope of
correction of filled data.
 Admission Schedule will be published in the Notice Board and in the Notice section of our
  college website.

Rules & Regulations of the College
The affiliating University has introduced FYUGP (NEP : 2020) in its undergraduate course from 2023.
This course will be conducted as per the regulations of the Gauhati University as reproduced below :
    a) The Four year degree course will be of eight semesters covering four calendar years.
    b) Classes of 1st, 3rd ,5th & 7th semesters will commence from June to November every year.
    c) Classes of 2nd, 4th , 6th & 8th semester will commence from December to May every year.
    d) 16st June to 16st July will be the period of semester break. Students’ performance will be
         monitored throughout the semesters by continuous assessment and evaluation in the theory
         and practical courses on the basis of both Internal & External Evaluation.
    e) Internal evaluation will be conducted on the basis of attendance, sessional examination, Home
       assignment, seminar and library works.
    f) External evaluation will be done on the basis of final examination conducted by the affiliating
         university at the end of every semester.
    g) A student who could not appear or failed in any semester will be allowed to clear the same as
         follows:
               First semester with the regular third semester examination.
              Second semester with the regular fourth semester examination.
              Third semester with regular fifth semester examination.
              Fourth semester with the regular sixth semester examination.
   h) A student is allowed to reappear in the theory papers in the first, second and third semester if the
              student secures less than 45% marks in the concerned paper.
   i)         No repeat/ betterment is allowed in practical examination in any semester.
   j)         A student must pass all the semester examinations including repeat and betterment chances within
              five years from the date of admission to the first semester.
   k) A student is allowed maximum three chances to clear a particular semester. No student is allowed
              to appear as private candidate.
   l)         A student must appear and pass in each subject in the sessional examination conducted by the
              college. Evaluated scripts are sent to the University for verification.


Rules Relating to Examination
   1. For the continuous evaluation of the students, the college conducts sessional examinations in an
              academic session. Appearance of the students in the examinations is mandatory.
   2. Students who do not appear in the sessional examination are not allowed to appear in the final
              examination.
   3. Mobile phone and any electronic gadgets are strictly prohibited in the examination hall.
   4. Admit Card, Registration Card, Identity Card are compulsory to produce in the examination hall.
   5. College authority will take disciplinary action against any unfair means adopted by students in the
              examination hall.

Attendance Rule
   1. Attendance in classes is mandatory. A student must attend at least 75% of the classes held, failing
              which he/she will be declared as non-collegiate student and will not be allowed to appear in their
              respective examinations.
   2. Non-collegiate student will also forfeit the benefit of scholarship .
   3. A student absent from classes continuously for 15 days or more without any valid reason shall
              forfeit his/her studentship.


   Students Discipline
   All Rules and Regulations for Higher Secondary, Degree and Masters Degree will be followed as per
   the guidelines of ASSEB/ Gauhati University.
   (a) Discipline : The college authority maintains the following Disciplines among the students :
         i.           Wearing of complete college uniform is compulsory.
        ii.           Students will have to bring their identity cards.
      iii.           Use of Mobile Phone and chewing and smoking of tobacco in any form in the college
                    premises is strictly prohibited.
     iv.            Ragging of any nature both within and outside the college campus is strictly prohibited.
      v.            Students are strictly warned not to disfigure walls and damage any college property.
     vi.            Students must park their vehicles in the specified places.
    vii.            During class hour, gossiping and movement of students in the verandah and corridors is
                    prohibited.
    viii.           Students are asked to go through the college notice board to keep them updated with the
                    happenings of the college.

College Central Library :
Jawaharlal Nehru College has a modern computerized college library. The library has an impressive
collection of books, journals, newspapers, magazines, e-Books, e-Journal, manuscript, Rare Books and
bibliographic databases etc. The library also provides access to e-resources to the teachers and students of
the college through UGC-INFLIBNET N-LIST programme along with institutional access to National
Digital Library of India. The library remains open from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. on all working days. It follows
 Open Access System and enjoys Library Automation with SOUL 20 Software, Wi-Fi facility is also
available in the library. The College Library has introduced Book Bank facilities to needy and deserving
students who may borrow books for the whole academic session.


Library Rules
    1. Each student is issued two library cards for an academic session. Two more Library Cards is
        given to students with honours subjects.
    2. No book is issued without Identity Card.
    3. Only one book is issued against one card.
    4. Books are issued only for a period of 15 days. At the expiry of the stipulated period the user will
        have to get reissued the same book from the library.
    5. Non return of books after stipulated period will attract a fine of Rs. 0.50 per day.
    6. An user will have to bring any damage of the book to the notice of the library staff at the time of
        receipt.
    7. At the event of damage or loss of book at the custody of the user, the user has to borne the market
        price or replace the same with new one.
       The students will have to return all the library books along with their library cards before one week of the
       commencement of each B.A./ B.Sc. semester and H.S. 1st and 2nd year final examinations Students must
       collect library clearance certificate to receive Admit Card.
    8. For duplicate library card, a sum of Rs. 50 will be charged.
    9. Library reading room facility can be availed by the students after submission of their identity
        card.
    10. Documentation of reading materials can be done in the library at the payment of necessary fee at
        the counter of the library as fixed by the authority.
    11. The decision of the college authority in any matter relating to library is final and binding.


Departmental Library :
All the Departments of the college have their own departmental library from which students can borrow
books complying with the rules laid down by the concerned department.


Infrastructure and Facilities
Digital Class Rooms :
The college is equipped with two audio-visual digital class rooms with all modern teaching facilities.
Laboratories :
With the financial support from University Grant Commission, Departmental Laboratories are set up with
all modern equipment’s and amenities. For the convenience of the students, laboratories are connected
with digital generator for uninterrupted power supply.
 Advanced Level Bio-Tech. Hub
Jawaharlal Nehru College has established an Institutional Biotech-Hub in January, 2011 with well
equipped laboratory and infrastructural facilities for teaching-learning and carrying out research in the
field of Biology/Biotechnology. It was sponsored by DBT Govt. of India and implemented by North
Eastern Region, Biotechnology Programme Management Centre (NER-BPMC), through Biotechnology
Consortium India Limited (BCIL). After regular monitoring based on performance the DBT has been
promoted to the Biotech Hub I the session 2016-17 with additional equipment and manpower grant.

Museum
Departments of Anthropology, Botany and Zoology have been maintaining departmental museums with
good number of precious collections of material culture and specimens.

Computer Lab
The college has three computer laboratories:

1.One computer Lab in the science building.

2, One in the Department of Mathematics.

3. The college has also another computer lab in collaboration with NIELIT, Guwahati, under Department
of Electronics & Information Technology, Ministry of Communication and Information Technology,
Govt. of India to extend IT facility for the college fratemity.


Star Status Scheme
Five science Departments Mathematics, Botany, Chemistry, Physics and Zoology of the college have
come under DBT Star Status Scheme from 2019. Earlier these five departments received grants under
DBT Star College scheme for more than three years. Degree students of science can avail various
facilities like Laboratory visits, Field Visits, Seminars, Student Resources Project etc. under this scheme.


Girl’s Hostel
The college has one Girl’s Hostel with 76 facilities. Admission is purely on merit basis.


Language Lab
The college has a well equipped language Laboratory under the Department of English for the
development of the language skills of students as well as teachers.


G.I.S. Lab
To facilitate advance research activities in Geo informatics and other disciplines, the college is equipped
with a G.I.S. laboratory for academic and research purposes.
 Sports Facilities
The college has been providing the following facilities to facilitate sports activities among students,
teachers and other beneficiaries-


Mini outdoor Stadium, Indoor Stadium with two synthetic Badminton courts along with facilities for
Table Tennis, Gymnasium Hall, Synthetic Volleyball Court, Swimming Pool and Play Ground.


Auditorium cum Community Hall
The college has an auditorium cum community hall to organize cultural events, meetings and different
college activities which has a seat capacity of nearly 1,000 people.


Smart class cum Conference Hall
The college has a well equipped smart class room cum conference hall for the use of students and teachers
and the stakeholders.


Common Room For Students
The college has provided separate Girls’ and Boys’ Common Room for recreation with adequate space
having indoor games facilities.


Teacher’s Common Room cum Conference Hall
The college has a common room cum Conference Hall for teachers equipped in indoor games and
recreational facilities.


Drinking Water Facilities :
The College has taken utmost care to provide pure drinking water in the college premises. In addition, the
college has also installed a cold drinking water system for the students.


Power Supply
The College is equipped with two 35 KVA generators for the purpose of providing uninterrupted power
supply for smooth management of the college activities.


Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)
The college has an Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) to sustain the quality of Higher Education.
The Cell constantly guides all activities and performances of the Teachers and Students.


J.N. College Science Forum
J.N. College Science Forum was established with an aim to promote the scientific empowerment among
 the rural people and young generations of greater Boko area and to create awareness and interest on basic

science. The Forum in collaboration with some other agencies arranges popular talk, exhibition, health
campaign, environmental awareness programme etc. at a regular interval of time.


Aryabhatta Sciece Centre, Boko Block
Aryabhatta Science Centre of Boko Block was established in 2011 under the Department of Physics
which is catalysed by ASTEC, Govt. of Assam and funded by Department of Science and Technology
Govt. of India. The activities of the centre are taken up in the interior parts of the Boko Development
Block to create awareness of science education among students at secondary level through the practice of
‘learning by doing’ method and thereby promote scientific temperament among rural masses and
consequently avail benefits of Science and Technology in their day to day life. Students are encouraged to
take up activity based programmes and there by facilitating them to participate in national level Science
and Technology programmes.


Rover and Ranger Units
Rover and Ranger unit of the college, under Bharat Scout and Guide, Assam has been participating in
different creative events organized in the college as well as outside the state. The purpose of the
movement is to develop young people as responsible citizen committed to the service of the mankind. So
far, the volunteers of the unit have made us proud bagging a number of prizes in different events
organized outside the state. Altogether 14 Rangers of the Unit have received the award of Rajya Puraskar
from the Hon’ble Governor of Assam during the period of 2015-2017. During the year 2020-21 the unit
secured first position in Lakshmi Mazumdar National Award.


National Cadet Corps (N.C.C.)
The NCC unit of the college is a voluntary organization of the students under the ministry of Home
affairs. The unit has been constituted recently to inculcate the sense of patriotism, nationality, self
discipline, national integration, building up of sound and moral character and building the leadership
quality among the students. The Cadets are given basic military training in small arms and parades.


Students’ Aid Fund
The college has been providing financial aid to poor meritorious students of economically backward
families. The students under this section may apply to the Principal to avail the aid.


Students Scholarship
The regular students can avail following scholarships strictly on merit basis.
     1. National Scholarship, Govt. of India.
    2. Ishan Uday Scholarship (NER), UGC, Govt. of India.
    3. State merit scholarship, Govt. of Assam.
    4. SC/ ST/ OBC/ MOBC/ Differently abled/ Tea garden labourer scholarships, Govt. of Assam.
    5. Nirman Shramik Scholarship.


Students travel concession
Students may avail second class train fare concession for academic excursion from the Ministry of
Railway, Govt. of India.


Award for Academic Excellence
Kulendra Narayan Mazumdar Memorial Award
Student securing highest marks (not below CGPA 7) in Mathematics (honours) in TDC Final Examiation.
(The award carries cash prize of Rs. 5000/-)
Akan Chandra Patowary Memorial Award
Student securing highest marks in Economics honours in TDC Final Examiation. (The award carries cash
prize of Rs. 5000/-)
Durgeswar Das Memorial Award
Student securing highest marks (above 80%) in Mathematics in H.S. Final Examination.
(The award carries cash prize of Rs. 5000/-)


Jawaharlal Nehru College Students’ Union (JNCSU)
Jawaharlal Nehru College Students’ Union (JNCSU) is a democratically elected body of students’
representatives. The body works towards all round development of the students by organizing different
cultural, social, literary activities both in and outside the college campus. It is the platform for the
development of leadership quality of the students. Election to the Students’ Union is held during the
month of September of each academic session.


College Magazine
The college publishes its Magazine ‘JAWAHAR JYOTI’ in every academic session. Articles are invited
from both students and teachers as well as interested writers to contribute to this magazine. The magazine
is considered as the mirror of the college and all possible care is taken by the magazine Secretary and the
Professor-in-charge to maintain the standard of the magazine.
 Cultural Unit
The Cultural Unit of the college has been playing a great role in fulfilling its mission of spreading the
colourful cultural heritage of the locality.


Centre For Gender Studies
With a vision to promote women empowerment and gender equality the Centre for gender studies has
been contributing towards the progress of academic and co-curricular aspects, related to women
employees and Girl students in particular and the all round development of women of society of the Boko
area. Periodically academic and other programmes are organized with the vision of creating a healthy
atmosphere for a gender friendly community within the college and the society.


Grievance Redressal Cell (G.R.C.)
The Grievance Redressal Cell of the college deals with all types of grievances, complaints and
malpractices including those received from students, faculty and other stakeholders. The cell comprises of
Principal, Vice-Principal and any three senior Heads of the Departments selected by the Principal. The
grievances and complaints are to be put in the complaint box available in front of the office of the
Principal and prompt actions are taken to redress the lodged complaints.


Information and Career Guidance Cell (ICGC)
The information and Career Guidance Cell of the college, creates awareness of career prospects, self
employment and entrepreneurship among the students. It also provides internet & Photostat facilities for
the benefit of students.


National Service Scheme (NSS)
To build up the leadership quality among the students and to bridge the campus with the community the
NSS unit of the college has been undertaking different activities since its inception. In order to motivate
and instill the sense of service towards the community, N.S.S. camps are organized both inside and
outside the college.


Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)
The ICC works as a task force to ensure safe working and learning environment for women employees
and girl students so that they may carry out their academic and professional responsibilities. It monitors
the existing security arrangements for girls and women within the college and provides an environment
conforming to Supreme Court guidelines and UGC recommendations.
 Anti Ragging Cell
As per the judgment of the Honourable Supreme Court, 2009 and the rules framed by UGC on curbing
Ragging in higher educational institutions, the college has its anti ragging cell. To check the menace of
ragging the entire campus has been put under the surveillance of CCTV.
Right to information cell (RTI)
Complying with the RTI act 2005 of Govt. of India, the college has constituted a cell involving some of
the senior teachers and office assistant.
Disaster Response Cell
To educate and create awareness among the students of the college in order to face and manage the event
of manmade and natural calamities, the college has constituted a disaster response cell comprising some
of the teachers, office staff and members from the students. This cell has already organized a number of
programmes on disaster response and management with the district authority.
College Canteen
The college canteen provides hygienic, nutritive food and beverages during college hours.
